description: Stormwater Reference Plans is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. This dataset represents areas of interest for construction plans within the City of Austin that have been used in the development of the Stormwater Infrastructure GIS by the Watershed Protection Department. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category City Infrastructure. Its tags are wpd, agoltosocrata, construction plans, stormwater, watershed protection department. The table has 12 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas – data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-03-16 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
